text:
Evan K: Hey everyone :wave: I'm Evan, started today in Eng. Working through the checklist but hit a few access issues — Okta MFA keeps asking for a push but my phone never receives it, 1Password invite hasn't shown up, and my Google account exists but I can't open Drive or Calendar. Who should I ping?

Marta (IT): Welcome Evan! :wave: I'll take a look. Can you confirm the exact email you used and whether you enrolled Okta Verify or set up SMS?

Evan K: My email is evan.k@redwood.com. I installed Okta Verify and tried to add the account but the app says 'Unknown account' when I scan the QR. No SMS set up yet.

Marta (IT): Got it. I'm re-sending the Okta activation and the 1Password invite now. Check spam/junk. Also quick troubleshooting: try reinstalling Okta Verify OR use the web fallback to set up TOTP. If push still fails, we can issue a temporary backup code.

it-ops-bot: Account provisioning update — Google Workspace account created for evan.k@redwood.com; groups: eng; shared-drive sync pending (eng-shared) — estimated completion ~10 min.

Liam: If Drive is blocked, I can drop the repo links in #eng or DM you a shared link until group sync finishes. Also hi Evan :wave:, happy to be your onboarding buddy.

Marta (IT): Evan — I just triggered a manual reprovision and re-sent invites. If you still see 'Unknown account' in Okta Verify, open the Okta web UI at https://redwood.okta.com and go to Security > Set up factor, then choose 'OKTA VERIFY' and scan the QR again. If that fails, I'll enable SMS for your account temporarily.

Evan K: Thanks — I tried the web flow and when I clicked 'Set up factor' I got an error: "Factor enrollment failed: profile not found".

Marta (IT): Thanks for the error text, that helped. I fixed a stale provisioning record and cleared the queue. Try again now. If it still fails, use a backup code to sign in: set of one-time codes will be sent to your email.

it-ops-bot: 1Password invite delivered to evan.k@redwood.com (resend).

Evan K: I got the 1Password invite! I also received a backup code email and was able to sign in to Okta with that. Drive/Calendar access appeared about 6 minutes after the bot message — I can see the eng calendar now. Thanks all :thumbsup:.

Priya: Welcome aboard Evan! If you don't see the 2pm onboarding calendar event in a few minutes, DM me and I'll add you manually.

Liam: Once you're in, join the #eng-standup thread and ping me for repo access. Also I'll send over the short onboarding checklist I used.

Evan K: All set for now. Big thanks to Marta and everyone for the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
